scope: length and mnemonic of 64-bit-mode instructions; mnemonics follow Intel names in Capstone's spelling (je not jz, cmove not cmovz, movabs for B8+r with REX.W, 'lock '/'rep ' fused into the mnemonic)

prefixes.evex: 62 (always EVEX in 64-bit mode): P0 R X B R' 0 m m m; P1 W vvvv 1 pp; P2 z L'L b V' aaa (SDM Vol 2A 2.7)
prefixes.xop: 8F with (next byte & 0x1F) >= 8: like 3-byte VEX, maps 8/9/A (AMD APM Vol 6); otherwise 8F is POP r/m
prefixes.legacy_prefix_opcodes_note: Opcodes with F2/F3 rows whose no-prefix row is a general-purpose instruction. A prefix with no row of its own keeps its legacy meaning only where listed: MOVBE (0F38 F0/F1, CRC32 at F2) takes 66 as operand size and refuses F3; BSF/BSR (0F BC/BD, TZCNT/LZCNT at F3) take 66 as operand size and ignore F2; 0F C7 (CMPXCHG8B/16B, RDRAND, RDSEED; RDPID and SENDUIPI at F3) takes 66 as operand size and ignores F2, and F3 where no F3 row fits the ModRM. On every other SSE-family opcode the highest-precedence prefix must have a row (XED: 66 0F38 F0 is MOVBE, F2 0F BC is BSF, F3 0F C7 /1 is CMPXCHG8B, but F2 66 0F 6F is invalid).

immediates.moffs: absolute address: 8 bytes, or 4 with 67 address-size (SDM Vol 2A 2.2.1.4)
immediates.wb: 3 bytes: a word then a byte (ENTER iw ib)

features: A row with `requires` decodes as itself only when the CPU profile has that feature; otherwise as its `fallback` (SDM: TZCNT executes as BSF and LZCNT as BSR on processors without the feature; ENDBR and RDSSP are NOPs without CET). Observed with XED chips PENTIUM4/SKYLAKE/ALL on 2026-10-08.
validity: Rows may carry `lock` (LOCK allowed on the memory form), `vvvv` ('1111' when the operand is unused), `l` (required VEX.L), `form`. An encoding outside these raises InvalidEncoding: the guest observes #UD (v0.2 section 5.1). Strict mandatory prefix: in the 0F/0F38/0F3A maps, an opcode whose rows include any mandatory-prefix row is an SSE-family opcode; a 66/F2/F3 prefix with no matching row means the bytes are a different instruction or invalid, never the unprefixed row. On opcodes with only unprefixed rows, 66 stays operand size.
